title: TensorPlate Health Event
description: Discrete health-state event emitted by the serving worker and consumed by `tensorplate-observability` and the V01-E10 ROS 2 health-topic publisher. Carries monotonic timing; never wall-clock.

kind.description: Discrete event kind. The set is union-stable: post-v0.1.0 additions append rather than rename.

monotonic_timestamp_ns.description: Receiver-monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds. Sampled from `std::chrono::steady_clock` (C++) or `std::time::Instant` (Rust). NEVER wall-clock.

sequence.description: Optional per-source monotonically increasing sequence number. Consumers use this to detect duplicate or out-of-order events when the producer supplies it.

source_id.description: Optional stable producer identifier, for example `serving_worker` or a worker process id label.

serving_state.description: Optional coarse serving-worker state carried with heartbeat or health events.

active_deployment.description: Optional active deployment identifier known to the serving worker.

backend.description: Optional active backend name known to the serving worker.

missed_deadline_rate.description: Optional bounded missed-deadline ratio for the current serving window.

correlation_id.description: Optional request correlation id (for `missed_deadline` / `overload` events tied to a specific request).

control_loop_metrics.description: Reserved control-loop telemetry fields (V01-E12). Defined in v0.1.0 so VLA validation runs can populate them without a schema bump.

rolling_window_seconds.description: Length of the rolling window for the metrics in this event. Default 60s per V01-E12.

message.description: Optional human-readable message; not parsed by the observability service.
